Symbolic System Kind

  • CURIE: gmeow:SymbolicSystemKind
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SymbolicSystemKind
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/notation

The domain or kind of a symbolic or notation system — a value, never an Entity subclass. The seed list is an anchor, not a fence; new domains may introduce further kinds without ontology modification.

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:SymbolicSystemKind as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
